title: Certify neutral fixed-frame two-edit obstruction at displacement two
body:
Close the specific neutral fixed-frame displacement-two gap released by [PR #3957](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3957) on both immutable PR[3734](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3734) staged544 providers. An existing ADD crosses exactly two scalar neighbours, retaining its source frame and zero paid delta; then any existing ADD may move to any legal scalar-corridor cut with any common binary frame. Every covered combined raw moment is non-improving for every real `0<a<1`.

The new reduction scans all ADDs belonging to the reordered three-instruction block and both interior insertion cuts for outside ADDs. All other prices map to the regenerated pinned single-move premise. It does not iterate a baseline theorem on an altered word. Scalar order may change under the declared commutation/conjugation rule; native maps/cuts, entrances, exits and other frames stay fixed. No global two-edit barrier, new supplier, kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Evidence

Each provider has 8,188 scalar-legal oriented first records; 154 violate frame legality, leaving 8,034 neutral fixed-frame words. Those expose 9,109,630 block-ADD prices and 4,616,377 outside-ADD interior-cut prices: **13,726,007 per provider, 27,452,014 total**. All 19 signed histogram types have exact all-exponent certificates. Counts are reduced price cases, not distinct circuits.

All 16,068 admitted first blocks pass exact rational arbitrary-dirty matrices. Both baselines and 18 first plus 18 final words pass the retained complete 723-input free-operator interpreter, both orientations, reverse pullback and cleanup. Edited whole-word replays are explicitly sampled; universal dirty coverage comes from local composition algebra.

Independent controls enumerate every first admission and all 308 rejections by direct monotone register itineraries. Across 40 phase/direction/operation-pattern cases, complete incremental traces and pricing geometry match fresh reconstruction; 13,404 interior-gap prices match unoptimized full reach, and 99,150 baseline-counterpart prices match exact masks and histograms. A production mutation omitting the second interior cut changes the receipt. Source/scalar/frame/cleanup/barrier rejection controls, 24 SCALE matrices and the credited Jeremy Kothe [PR #2957](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2957) recovery all pass, including under `-O`.

An early trusted-target implementation overcounted across a native B segment barrier (first B978→976, outside ADD989 at cut977). The independent full-reach control caught it. Segment clipping was corrected and both complete generations restarted from zero; interrupted attempts are excluded from evidence. VALIDATION.json preserves the failure history and precise scope.

## Cost and verification

The ledger retains 3,519 baseline children, rank mass 5,134, 408 helper roles, 91 dirty buffers, all primitive/native counts, 72 native B warps and 36 initial corrections. Every first invoice equals the baseline. Second relaxed profiles have 3,519–3,521 children with unchanged rank mass. The finite all-edit numerator/denominator bound is 11 bits, not a uniform precision tariff. Fresh native phase, physical hosting/owner chronology, uniform precision/stock/tape, all-size compiler, complete outer/supplier, analytic and BIT obligations remain inherited or unknown, never zero.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/staged544-neutral-fixed-d2
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/staged544-neutral-fixed-d2 --check-source-history
```

Python 3.12.3 standard library: separate complete provider generations passed in 311.28s and 308.28s while concurrent. Final normal and optimized controls passed in 76.36s and 79.87s. The exact public committed-byte and full-history source gate passes for all 29 package files. Immutable snapshots are authenticated by byte count, SHA256 and Git blob; external source heads are attribution pins, not claimed ancestors.

The uninterrupted official registered replay passes at exact public head `cf80e9c38b35e13bb3226a423f0246d39956ae42`: both complete provider commands, optimized controls and the final `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` marker; exit 0, 472.82s total. This is distinct from the pre-publication science snapshot recorded inside VALIDATION.json.

The official committed export passes integrity checking; its Git-free optimized controls pass in 65.26s. All export/package bytes remain unchanged. The export is a deterministic uncompressed tar (419,840 bytes), SHA256 `64b67338b99e5cd2de14faee01cdcb025717666a9d7b851c8e6d2e701d0a3262`. Hosted CI and independent human/formal review are separate from local execution.

## Scope, coordination and credit

Adds only `research/staged544-neutral-fixed-d2/`, 29 files. Exact GitHub-authored head: `cf80e9c38b35e13bb3226a423f0246d39956ae42`; sole parent canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority 6. The full local index equals GitHub tree `5863729c98cb6c3fd1d063ce8e1152966feb4b87`. Entry overlap used 662 open PR bodies plus partial signed-in handoffs. A fresh complete 672-open-PR-body cache was checked at 07:23:42 UTC with the current overlap helper; canonical main remained unchanged and no new matching neutral fixed-frame displacement-two work was found within this coverage. Discussion pagination remains partial. No exhaustive novelty claim. [Scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19034212).

Credit dataisfire/[PR #3734](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3734); [PR #3886](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3886)'s single-move theorem, trace, applier and signs; [PR #3941](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3941)'s adjacent-cut reduction and dirty matrices; [PR #3942](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3942)'s interval pricing; and [PR #3957](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3957)'s explicit gap and verification/ledger scaffolding. Retain Jeremy Kothe/[PR #2957](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2957)/[PR #2979](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2979) and the staged-entry lineage, Dugongue/[PR #3863](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3863), Sagar Thakrar's auditor, roger-sato's adapter and Arham Tahir's frame-contract attribution. These semantic tools are credited reuse. New three-instruction reduction, census and independent controls by Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0 and retained notices apply.

The parallel stationary-frame contribution [PR #3964](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3964) is distinct: it holds scalar order fixed and addresses the direct-intermediate compatibility question. Here the first ADD moves exactly two positions. A useful successor changes the event graph or native/caller contract and supplies one exact before/after identity, arbitrary-dirty restoration and a full paid/physical invoice. Farther radii remain outside this package, but no automatic radius expansion is proposed. README.md and TASK.json retain concrete first steps and blockers.
